clearedSpotChecks.note: The code lines hold: Lock.sol:8 and :10-28 use TSTORE and TLOAD on one slot, NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:9-32 keeps the count in transient storage, PoolManager.sol:104-114 reverts with CurrencyNotSettled when the count is nonzero before Lock.lock, and Hooks.sol:131-137 bubbles a failed hook call up as a revert. The chainIds list includes 480 and 7777777, whose journal code the unit did not run (World Chain is an open lead and the Zora binary was not obtained), so for those two the item rests on less than its wording says. I ran one read-only eth_call with a state override on chains 480, 7777777 and 10: a contract that writes 1 to transient slot 0 and storage slot 0, calls itself so the inner frame writes 2 to both and reverts, then returns TLOAD(0) and SLOAD(0). All three returned (1, 1), so the inner revert restored both words. That is one shape and does not replace the lift.
